parameters.name: CustomTemplate
parameters.description:
The custom template in JSON format: {height:xxx,scale:xxx,gop:xxx,bframes:xxx,cdesc:xxx}. All fields are required. If any field is missing, the call fails.

> For more information about the parameters, see the **CustomTemplate description** table below.

parameters.name: Template
parameters.description:
The name of the template to add.
>Record the template name when you create the template. The template name is required for using, querying, and deleting the template.
